title: Weekly poll results: a clear favorite emerges from the Google Pixel 11 family
description: Last week, we asked you which Pixel 11 model you would buy and now the results are in. The sentiment is trending towards negative with price being a common reason for skipping the 11 series. Looking at the overall poll, many just aren’t interested in any Pixel 11 model. But those that do want one are mostly leaning towards the Pixel 11 Pro – it almost got more votes than the vanilla and the Pro XL models put together. Almost. The Pro XL is a distant second, while the pricey foldable barely got any love. Focusing in on the Google Pixel 11 Pro, it received the biggest proportion of...

title: Deals: the Pixel 11 series is now on sale, the Galaxy Z8 foldables come with gift cards
description: The Google Pixel 11 series went on sale this Thursday, but Amazon is still maintaining the pre-order deals – for now. This means that the phones come with an Amazon Gift Card and trade-in bonuses (the values depend on each model). Actually, this week the trade-in bonuses are higher than they were last week ($250 for all four models). For example, the vanilla Pixel 11 has a $324 trade-in bonus. The Pro and Pro XL models get $425 trade-in bonuses. The foldable gets a $425 trade-in bonus and either a $350 gift card or a free Pixel Watch 5. ...

title: vivo T5 5G teased with a 3D curved display ahead of launch
description: vivo's T5 series has five smartphones, including the T5 4G, which was unveiled in May. The brand will soon unveil the T5 5G as the next member of the lineup, as it has started teasing the smartphone in India. vivo says the T5 5G will have "Faster AI with GenAI Ready NPU" and a 3D curved display. The vivo T5 5G is also advertised to have an "Ultra Slim Body," but its exact slimness isn't known. A video posted by vivo India on its official X account suggests the T5 5G will feature a horizontally aligned camera island on its rear, like the vivo S2, but there's no confirmation on how...

title: Pixel 11 Pro Fold's durability test shows Google made the same mistake four times in a row
description: About two weeks ago, Zack from YouTube channel JerryRigEverything subjected the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 to a durability test. Now, he’s put the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold through one too. [#InlinePriceWidget,14874,1#] Zack starts with his usual scratch tests on the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, followed by the flame test. He then pours sand and grit over the foldable. Finally, Zack performs the bend test on the Pixel 11 Pro Fold, showing Google made the same design mistake for the fourth time in a row, as the Pixel 11 Pro Fold cracked along both antenna lines like the previous three foldables...

title: Here's the Sony Xperia 10 VIII that's expected to launch next week
description: Sony recently announced a launch event for August 25, starting at 11 AM Japan time. Sony said it's for a new Xperia product but didn't reveal its name. This Xperia product is expected to be the Xperia 10 VIII, which was recently spotted on Geekbench and has now appeared in an official-looking image shared by Android Headlines. The image below shows the Xperia 10 VIII's design, which is almost identical to its predecessor - the Xperia 10 VII. It shows a dual-camera setup on the rear, placed inside a horizontally aligned camera island sporting the Sony logo. The NFC logo is also visible...

title: Deals: Pixel 11 lineup goes on sale, latest Galaxy phones get discounts
description: The Google Pixel 11 series, which went up for pre-order last week, is now officially available for purchase on Amazon UK. Alongside the Pixel phones, Samsung’s latest Galaxy foldables and the Galaxy S26 series have received price cuts. While the Google Pixel 11 lineup hasn’t received any price cut, users are eligible for an added trade-in bonus when exchanging a compatible used phone. title: iQOO is allegedly working on a small and powerful tablet
description: According to a new rumor from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, after having launched quite a few larger tablets, iQOO is getting ready to enter the small tablet space, directly competing with the RedMagic Astra 2, which was released back in June. The iQOO tablet is rumored to have an 8.8-inch screen with an "ultra-high" refresh rate and narrow bezels on all four sides, a metal frame, and a built-in cooling fan. The much larger iQOO Pad6 Pro It will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset. Unfortunately, no other details about it are known at the moment. We'll let you...

title: vivo V70 Lite 4G arrives with 8,100mAh battery and IP69 rating
description: The vivo V70 Lite was announced back in June, and its 4G counterpart has not been listed across several markets in Eurasia. As the name implies, this device features a 4G chipset – specifically Unisoc’s T7300. It is paired with 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 128/256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. The phone also brings an 8,100mAh battery with support for 44W wired charging. V70 Lite 4G is built around a 6.83-inch AMOLED featuring 1,260 x 2,800px resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. It also features an optical fingerprint scanner and a 32MP front-facing camera. The back houses a 50MP main cam and a 2MP...

title: Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max India launch date leaks along with pricing details
description: The Redmi Note 17 series is getting its global launch next week, but that won't include India. Over there, the Redmi Note 17 is already official, while today new details about the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max have surfaced. According to a new report, the two Pro devices will be made official for India on September 15. The Pro is said to have a 9,000 mAh battery just like its Chinese counterpart, while the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max will have a 10,000 mAh battery and will be powered by the Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 SoC. This device will feature a 6.8-inch OLED screen with a 120Hz...

title: Poco X8 and X8 Power marketing materials leak
description: A few hours ago a rumor claimed Poco would soon launch the X8 Power with a 10,000 mAh battery. Now a different tipster on X has shared some purported marketing materials for both the X8 Power as well as the long-awaited X8. We'll just say it outright: these seem to be rebrand jobs. Specifically, the X8 appears to be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro, and the X8 Power may be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro Max. There are some very slight differences, but not many. According to these slides, the X8 has a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen with 3,500-nit peak brightness and Gorilla Glass Victus 2 on...

title: Here's how much you'll pay if you break the Honor Robot Phone's gimbal camera
description: Honor's Robot Phone was finally made official last week after many months of teasers and showcases. It's definitely a unique device, with its integrated gimbal camera, even if it's not actually a robot. That gimbal camera, though, contains a lot of moving parts, so if you drop the phone while it's out, you might damage it. In that case, you will have to pay a whopping CNY 3,079 ($457) to replace it. The number comes from Honor's official website in China, where it just published its repair prices for the Robot Phone. Replacing the telephoto camera will cost CNY 879 ($130), while the...

description: Last month, Samsung acknowledged reports that the Galaxy S26 Ultra display can have a red tint under certain conditions and promised a fix for it – the company blamed it on a software issue, not a hardware one. Said fix is coming by the end of the month, according to Samsung’s customer support team in Korea. One user on the Samsung Community forum posted a screenshot of a conversation with support, which claims that the fix is currently being evaluated by the verification department. title: RayNeo unveils productivity-focused iO glasses and multimedia-focused GT glasses
description: RayNeo, one of the top AR smart glasses companies out there (with 23.7% market share, based on Counterpoint data for Q1 2026), unveiled two new product lines – the iO and the GT series. The former focuses on “glanceable” ambient intelligence, the latter is all-in on multimedia (games and movies). The RayNeo iO Smart Glasses have a lightweight build for all-day wear. They weigh 33g and have an even 50:50 weight distribution between the front and the back. description: The European Commission may be happy with Apple’s new app store rules, but Epic Games sure isn’t. description: The Poco X8 series currently comprises the X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max, with a base X8 model also rumored to be in the works. Now, a new leak claims that Poco is preparing to launch an X8 Power variant as well. According to a tipster, the Poco X8 Power could debut soon with a massive 10,000mAh battery. The tipster has also shared the phone's full specifications, suggesting that it could be a rebranded Redmi Note 17 Pro Max, which is set to launch next week. description: Now that we've welcomed the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 to the office, we can say we've completed the set. And it's a very pink and purple set indeed. We've got the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra reviews over here if you want to check those out, but now let's have a look at the Z Flip8. title: Honor Turbo 5G silently unveiled
description: Following a recent listing on AliExpress, Honor Turbo 5G is now official. The official listing on Honor Eurasia confirms the previously leaked specs which include the Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset, a 6.79-inch AMOLED (FHD+120Hz), an 8,560 mAh battery and IP69 ingress protection. The phone ships with MagicOS 10 based on Android 16 and also features a 50MP main cam and a 5MP ultrawide lens. It is available in black, green and orange colors and starts at RUB 33,990 ($411) in Russia.

title: vivo V80 Lite with 10,000mAh battery to debut on September 3
description: The vivo V80 Lite appeared on an Indian retailer’s Instagram page earlier this week, hinting at an imminent launch. Now, the official vivo Malaysia website has confirmed the phone’s launch, albeit with a different design. vivo Malaysia has announced that the V80 Lite 5G will launch in the country on September 3. The company has also confirmed that the phone will pack a 10,000mAh battery. The company has also revealed the design of the upcoming smartphone.
